verdict.rationale: No documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting appears in the evidence. The only related support is community testimony that the RDK is open source except the cloud app and can run with no outside communication [viam-comm-3], and that robots keep operating offline with locally cached configs [viam-comm-1]. That suggests a self-hosted or offline workaround rather than an actual opt-out control. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out flag or setting, first-party docs on what usage data viam-server, the CLI and the app collect, privacy controls in the cloud app, and independent corroboration.
